# POS Settings Explained

# Point of Sale: POS Settings Explained

Most till behaviour is set once for your whole store, on **Settings** → **POS** tab. The settings apply to every till at every location. This article explains each one and what it changes at the counter.

* Note: These cards only appear once **Enable Pixfizz POS** is on.

---

## POS Behavior

Change any switch, then click **Save changes**. Tills pick the changes up within a few minutes.

![POS Behaviour](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/b82aad55-ee3a-43ca-b7f8-f157c2e42e93.png)

| Setting | Default | What it does at the till |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Enforce customer selection** | Off | Every sale needs a customer. The cart shows **Customer required — tap to select**, and guest checkout isn't allowed. |
| **Allow pay at pickup** | Off | Adds **Pay at Pickup** at checkout. The order is placed with nothing taken, and the balance stays due until the customer collects. A customer must be attached. |
| **Custom sales taxable by default** | On | Sets the starting position of the **Taxable** switch on the **Custom sale** screen. Staff can still change it per item. |
| **Clear customer on Pickup selection** | On | Opening **Pickup** from the side menu removes any customer selected on the current sale. |
| **Clear customer on Orders selection** | On | The same, for **Orders**. |
| **Cash drawer command** | Epson / ESC-POS printer | How the till opens a cash drawer connected to your receipt printer: **Epson / ESC-POS printer**, **Star printer (Line Mode)** or **Printer driver opens it (Star TSP100)**. The drawer only opens for cash sales, and only if your receipt layout has **Kick cash drawer** turned on. |
| **Auto-complete tracked stock at the till** | Off | Products that track stock are completed at the till with no production step. See **Products That Don't Need Production**. |
| **Auto pick-up on handover** | On | When nothing on a paid sale needs production, the order is marked picked up straight away. When off, these orders go to the **Pickup** queue instead. |
| **Custom sales need production** | On | Sets the starting position of the **Needs production** switch on the **Custom sale** screen. |

---

## Manual Discounts

Lets staff take an ad-hoc percentage off a sale. Turn on the switch in the card's header, then set:

* **Maximum discount**: the largest percentage allowed on one order.
* **Allowed roles**: which POS roles can apply one: **Counter staff**, **Supervisor**, **Manager**. By default only managers can.
* **Discount reasons**: the list staff must choose a reason from. Add at least one.

![Manual discounts](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/6842e75d-1bfc-45b4-9210-27addb2a7b06.png)

* Note: A manual discount can't be combined with a discount code or a gift card on the same sale.

---

## Refund Reasons

The reasons staff choose from when issuing a refund. The defaults are **damaged**, **changed_mind**, **wrong_order**, **quality_issue** and **other**. The till shows them in plain words.

* Note: Stick to the five default reasons for now. A custom reason can be added here, but a refund using it can't be saved yet.

---

## End of Day

How shifts and days are closed. This is covered in **End of Day: Shifts, Floats and Reports**.

---

## Cash denominations

The quick-tap amounts on the cash payment screen, for example 5, 10, 20 and 50. Add up to 10, in the order you want them shown, and click **Save cash denominations**.

![Cash Denominations](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/07b4a31b-db08-498e-acf8-9fdfb7a779bb.png)

---

## Settings elsewhere that affect the till

| Setting | Where | Effect at the till |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **POS Tax Percentage** | **Settings** → **POS** → **Pixfizz POS** card | The tax charged on till sales. See **Turning On Pixfizz POS**. |
| **Force Payment before Pickup** | **Settings** → **Info** tab | Orders must be paid in full before they can be marked picked up, shipped or completed. In-house account orders are exempt. |
| **Auto-complete pickup orders** | **Settings** → **Info** tab → **Pickup Auto-Complete** | When all jobs on a pickup order finish, the order is marked **Completed** (so it appears in the till's **Pickup** queue) instead of **Ready**. This sends the standard "completed" email and SMS. |
| **Enable Pick Up Tracking** | **Settings** → **Info** tab → **Pick Up Tracking** | Tracks completed pickup orders that haven't been collected. |
| **Minimum Charge** | **Settings** → **Pixfizz** tab → your website → **General** tab | Turn on **Apply minimum charge** and enter an amount. Sales below it get a top-up added before tax. |
| **Default receipt layout** | **PDF Layout Studio** | On a receipt layout, click **Set as default for POS receipts**. Without one, the till can't print receipts. |
| **Payment methods** | **Settings** → **Payments** tab | Which payment methods staff can use. See **Payment Options at the Till**. |
